- **Warning caveat:** `--text-warning` intentionally equals `--primary`. Warning states must therefore **never rely on color alone** — always pair with an icon and/or text label.

## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- All styling lives in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is **forbidden** anywhere in the HTML.
- Target all design properties, layout rules, and states exclusively via class/ID selectors.
- HTML must remain clean, semantic (header/nav/main/section/article/footer), and agnostic of visual styling — retheming must require editing only `style.css`.
- No inline event handlers (`onclick=` etc.); all behavior attaches via `addEventListener` in `script.js`.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
- Every color, radius, shadow, spacing, duration, easing, and z-index value must come from the tokens in 0.4. No hard-coded hex/px values inside component rules; rgba-based shadows/glows are defined once as tokens.
- Contrast pairing (0.4) is enforced for every fill/text combination used anywhere on the page.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- Dark mode is mandatory and is this theme's native mode: the full dark token set lives in `:root`, plus `color-scheme: dark` so native controls, scrollbars, and form fields render dark.
- Theming must never require HTML restructuring — token overrides only.
- ***Exception (per source specification "Light: ✗ No / Dark: ✓ Full"): this theme is dark-only — do NOT build a light palette, a light/dark toggle, or localStorage persistence. If a light theme is ever added later, it must be a token-overriding `.light` class only; its backgrounds must never be pure `#ffffff` (use `#fefefe`), and every light background token must pair with a dark text token.***

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build all layout structure with Flexbox.
- Every flex container **defaults to `align-items: center`**. Exceptions are allowed only with a CSS comment stating the reason (e.g., `align-items: stretch` for equal-height Features/Pricing card rows; `align-items: flex-start` for form label stacks and footer columns).
- Mobile-first: single-column below 768px; rows convert to columns on small viewports; **zero horizontal scrolling at any width ≥ 320px**.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
- Use Tailwind CSS, or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind's `@layer`/`@apply` directives. All utility usage must map back to CSS variables or generic reusable component classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.section-label`).

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Google Fonts for text (JetBrains Mono) and Google Material Symbols for icons, per 0.5. Inline SVGs and local icon files are explicitly forbidden.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button**
- **Base `.btn`:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px; uppercase label, letter-spacing 0.08em, weight 700; square corners (`--radius-sm`); `transition: all var(--transition-normal) var(--ease-standard)`.
- **Variants:** `.btn--primary` (fill `--primary`, text `--accent-ink`); `.btn--outline` (transparent, 1px `--secondary` border, text `--text-primary`); `.btn--ghost` (borderless, cyan text, hover underline/background); `.btn--danger` (error-red border/fill + warning icon).
- **Hover:** brightness shift and/or glow shadow; `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus-visible:** distinct ring — `outline: 2px solid var(--secondary); outline-offset: 2px;` — clearly visible over the dark grid.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading `.is-loading`:** interactions disabled (prevents double-clicks/double submits), `aria-busy="true"`, CSS spinner (rotating border ring) or animated Material Symbol `progress_activity`; button dimensions must not change while loading.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5; filter: grayscale(1); cursor: not-allowed;` hover/focus/active styles suppressed.
- **Success/Error:** `.is-success` / `.is-error` — icon swap (`check_circle` / `error`) plus token-driven color; never color alone.

**2.2 Card**
- **Base `.card`:** flex column; background `--bg-secondary`; `1px solid var(--border-default)`; relative positioning for crosshair/annotation pseudo-elements.
- **Hover (interactive cards):** `transform: translateY(-2px)`; border shifts to `--secondary`; glow via `--shadow-glow-cyan` + `--shadow-md`.
- **Focus-within:** border highlights to `--primary` when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (Skeleton) `.card--skeleton`:** shimmer keyframe (linear-gradient sweep) over placeholder blocks — define and ship this CSS even if static content doesn't use it.
- **Empty State `.card--empty`:** centered Material icon + heading + guidance text fallback layout.
- **Variants to build:** `.card--feature`, `.card--step`, `.card--testimonial`, `.card--pricing`, `.card--pricing--featured`.

**2.3 Form & Input**
- **Structure `.input-group`:** flex column wrapping a `<label for="…">`, the input, and a dedicated error container `.input-group__error` with reserved `min-height` (prevents layout shift) and `aria-live="polite"`.
- **States:** Empty; Focused (cyan ring: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--secondary)`); Filled; Valid `.is-valid` (success border + `check_circle` icon); Invalid `.is-invalid` (error border, `error` icon, message text in the error container — never color alone); Disabled (opacity, `cursor: not-allowed`); Read-only.
- Validate the email format in JS; on submit, drive the button through loading → success/error states with an `aria-live` status message.

**2.4 Modal / Popup**
- **States:** opening, open, loading, success/error, closing — all animated via CSS transitions (opacity + scale/translate, `var(--transition-normal)`).
- **UX:** centered flex container (`align-items: center; justify-content: center`); backdrop overlay `rgba(4,10,18,0.75)` with subtle grid; close button using Material `close` icon with `aria-label`; `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby`; keyboard focus trapping; close via `Esc` and overlay click; focus returns to the triggering element.
- Apply this pattern to any overlay in the build (e.g., a "View full spec" dialog). The mobile nav panel must at minimum support `Esc` to close, `aria-expanded` on its trigger, and correct z-index (`--z-dropdown`).

**2.5 Accordion (FAQ)**
- Trigger is a real `<button>` with `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`; panel has `role="region"` + `aria-labelledby`.
- Animate open/close via `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` (or equivalent) with `var(--transition-normal)`; icon (`expand_more` or `add`) rotates on open.
- The collapsed state must be applied by JS at initialization so that **without JS, all answers remain visible**. Single-open behavior is optional.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by Default:** fluid `clamp()` type scale; breakpoints ≈ 640/768/1024px; `scroll-margin-top` on sections for the sticky header; smooth anchor scrolling CSS-first: `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { html { scroll-behavior: smooth; } }`. No horizontal overflow at any width.
- **Smooth Animations:** every state change transitions with `var(--transition-normal) var(--ease-standard)`. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, disable transforms, shimmer, parallax, and smooth scroll; keep instant opacity changes only.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** WCAG AA contrast everywhere on the dark background; never rely on color alone to communicate state (especially warnings, which share the accent orange); semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section[aria-labelledby]`, `footer`); a skip-to-content link; exactly one `<h1>` with a logical heading order; visible focus indicators on all interactive elements; full keyboard operability (nav, accordion, forms, modal); `aria-live` regions for form feedback, loading, and dynamic status; all decorative graphics `aria-hidden="true"`.
- **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive Actions:** any destructive control uses `.btn--danger` — visually distinct (red border/fill + icon) and clearly differentiated from the orange primary in the dark theme.

## 5. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

**5.1 File Structure**
Three files: `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. HTML includes `lang="en"`, meta viewport, title, meta description, Google Fonts links with `preconnect`, skip link, and exactly one `<script src="script.js" defer></script>` — no other script tags, no inline styles, no inline handlers. `style.css` is organized in `@layer`s (reset → tokens → components → sections). `script.js` is vanilla JS — no external libraries, no console errors.

**5.2 Naming Convention**
**BEM only** (`block__element--modifier`), e.g., `.btn--primary`, `.card--feature__icon`, `.accordion__trigger`, `.input-group__error`. Never mix conventions; HTML carries only BEM class names (Tailwind is consumed via `@apply`/`@layer` inside `style.css`).

**5.3 Copy Rules**
All user-facing copy in **English**, realistic and theme-appropriate for a Data & Engineering product; one consistent brand name throughout; **no lorem ipsum**; real-sounding testimonial names/roles; genuine FAQ questions and answers.

**5.4 JavaScript Scope (exhaustive)**
Mobile nav toggle; accordion initialization/animation; email form validation with button loading/success/error states and `aria-live` feedback; header scrolled-state class; optional IntersectionObserver reveal animations (content must remain visible without JS and under reduced motion). Nothing else — no trackers, no network calls.

**5.5 Acceptance Checklist**
Zero horizontal overflow at 320px; full keyboard-only pass (logical tab order, visible focus, `Esc` closes nav/modal); WCAG AA contrast on all text; `prefers-reduced-motion` pass; no inline styles or handlers; every button/link wired to real behavior; native controls render dark via `color-scheme: dark`.

Deliver the complete build in one response: `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`.
